gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-mozilla-text: Casual and personal, Coming Soon writes its letters with arms and legs of constant width. Mozilla Text handles the sturdier side, its lowercase bodies so tall they look bold, terminals flaring outward.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-nata-sans: Loose, personal handwriting up top: Coming Soon rings its o with a constant wall. Nata Sans takes the tidier job, curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths drawn with a technical pen's steadiness.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-nobile: Skimming, casual handwriting: Coming Soon keeps one stroke weight and lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals. Nobile meets it with chalk-arc open mouths and hardly any gap between lowercase and caps, so the two feel linked.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-nokora: Nokora reads thick and dark, a wide-open s never tightening in a stripe of lowercase through every line. And Coming Soon, whose letters are rods rather than carved blades, loosens things up with a handwritten feel.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text gives each curved letter a large, visible entrance, its lowercase bodies filling most of the height. But Coming Soon wins on warmth, its handwritten strokes never tapering where they meet or end.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Modern and clean, the body face leaves a welcoming gap in the c and keeps capitals barely above lowercase. Noto Kufi Arabic sits under Coming Soon, whose monoline strokes run start to finish like a quick note.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans: Casual from the first letter, Coming Soon rounds its o with a rim that matches the stems, so everything feels hand-drawn. Noto Sans grounds that warmth with a wide-open c and tall bodies.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Casual to its core, Coming Soon has stems matching its hairlines, because it has none. Noto Sans Adlam does the tidying, keeping curve endings well apart while lowercase c, s and z stand tall and full.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Strokes like cut ribbon, constant in width, give Coming Soon a casual hand with a ring-shaped o. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined stays quiet so Coming Soon can earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Every stroke carries the same visual weight in Coming Soon, a handwritten face with a ringlike o. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs counters with outward-pointing terminals and an x-height rising close to cap height.
